purpose: Separate, case-control source-only enrichment for the UNKNOWN test. The first 108-frame blind panel is retained unchanged. Its two confirmed natural misses fell in a single Quad recording and it contained no Waymo or Drone confirmed misses.
input: Waymo source training input only. Exclude complete recordings represented in the first Waymo panel, exact frames and identical media from the first panel and the earlier excluded stacks. Try 192 frames or all eligible natural phrases, at most four per recording. The input is independent of evaluation labels.
recruitment: Run unchanged, frozen D. For all eligible annotated same-class same-side objects, compute the fixed coverage rule before visual truth is available. Invite up to 24 cases with at least one potential natural miss, balanced across available recordings and preferring a higher fraction of potential misses. Invite up to 12 controls with zero potential misses and at least one covered option, prioritizing recruitment from the same recordings. Reject no review cases retrospectively. Neither the reviewer nor the evaluated scorer receives the invitation stratum or the inventory-coverage outputs.
reference_labels: Visually check every invitation against the original unaltered RGB and the independent source annotation inventory. Seal individual reference identities and any independently verified distinct foils before opening selected-candidate or scoring outcomes.
folds: The first Waymo panel and other invited Waymo recordings may provide calibration labels. Exclude the held-out recording as a whole. Repeat separately for the original D, D-only classifier, aligned cues and the same shifted-feature control with the original frozen pooling, scoring and thresholds.
metrics: Separate matched comparisons for natural misses and true covered references. Report each stratum and recording source, rank and correct accepted outcome plus finite support. Treat these enriched counts as a case-control test, not the Waymo prevalence of missing reference.
joint_decision: The original protocol requires improvement of the original panel's rank and genuinely useful held-out UNKNOWN with no loss of correct covered acceptance. The enriched panel gives an additional held-recording direct check of correct reference selection among all candidates. Any reduction of correct acceptance relative to D or D-only in either panel blocks reintegration.
